cases.name: headings, preamble, role prefixes, markup and an empty heading
cases.script:
Morning light before any heading.

## Hook: A tiny seed
Have you seen a small seed grow **tall** beside a quiet garden wall?

## A rainy day
Rain falls softly while the gardener walks
along the narrow path.

Another paragraph, same scene — still growing.

## Empty heading

## Wrap:
More leaves, brighter flowers. These are the signs of a new spring.

cases.script:
Well, um, here comes the rain.
Small flowers bloom beside the old gate.

   
Look now, a bird carries a seed.

Leave the gate open.
